abilities.desc: Fold space and step out somewhere else. Aim at an enemy and you step out behind its back.
abilities.variants: Level: step up to 14 blocks where you look, or behind the enemy you aim at. Up: rise 9 blocks and drift down; the hole you leave collapses a moment later, crushing whoever stands in it. Down: fold 9 blocks backwards; a black echo of you stays behind and detonates after a second.

abilities.desc: A slow orb of nothing that drags enemies into it and implodes.
abilities.variants: Level: the orb drifts forward for 3 s, pulling everything within 5 blocks and stinging what touches it. Up: it races ahead, anchors, lifts enemies into the air and slams them into the ground. Down: a near-invisible rift mine; when an enemy comes close it swells and violently implodes.

abilities.desc: Reach through the void at a target up to 20 blocks away and leave it lost in darkness.
abilities.variants: Level: swap places with the target (Oblivion: hurl it into the sky instead). Up: rip the target through a rift to your feet and root it. Down: swap, and a rift under its new spot collapses after 1.5 s unless it gets out.

abilities.desc: Open a black hole that swallows everything around it, then collapses in a blinding shockwave.
abilities.variants: Level: opens where you look and pulls for 6 s; the last second shrieks a warning before the collapse. Up: Crown of Nothing - it hovers over your head and follows you while you fight in its eye. Down: the void folds in at once - a 1.5 s windup, then everything within 12 blocks is yanked in and crushed.

p1d: Incoming arrows, tridents and ability projectiles have a 15% chance to pass straight through you.
p2d: Melee hits shroud enemies in Darkness for 3 s.
awd: Void Step leaves a rift open where you stood for 5 seconds; cast it again to return through it.
